remarks: **SELLER REQUESTS ALL OFFERS WITH COMPLETE TERMS IN BY MONDAY 4PM **Set on a quiet cul-de-sac, this classic Colonial offers a wonderful blend of comfort, convenience, and everyday livability. The bright, open kitchen features generous space for cooking, gathering, and entertaining, with a large window overlooking the backyard and sliders opening to an expansive deck. Ideally located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, specialty shopping, cafes, Stamford Museum & Nature Center, and Bartlett Arboretum & Gardens, the home also offers beach rights and easy access to NYC in under an hour. Recent improvements include a new roof and gutters, freshly painted exterior, new washer and dryer, updated downstairs bath, all-new windows, and interior painting.
